name: Funk
summary: The fashion components of Funk included specific garment types such as flared trousers, jumpsuits, and suits with wide lapels.
description: The fashion components of Funk included specific garment types such as flared trousers, jumpsuits, and suits with wide lapels. Fabrics like polyester, satin, sequins, and velvet were common. Color palettes ranged from bright, sometimes psychedelic , tones to later earth tones. Hairstyles like the Afro were also associated with this aesthetic. The visual and cultural expression of Funk often reflected themes of self-development, personal liberation, and social commentary, with musical lyrics taking on urgent social commentary.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Self-expression, individuality, cultural pride, liberation, energetic movement, rebellion against convention

visualDNA.colour: Bright primary colors, neon hues, vibrant purples, oranges, blues, golds, earth tones (later in 1970s)
